data.message: Your 10-ton plan guarantees full recovery if followed; 18 loses that guarantee. I still commit to 18. If all others take 10, 242 remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 484 (25%). Each of you may opt for 18 even if others take 10: $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. Conditional supporters: clarify your exact catch and conditions; no agreement assumed.
